freeze_commit: the git commit containing this manifest and scorer; resolved by history rather than a recursive self-hash
question: Does the archived pre-outcome ordered support state explain held-out Rminus variation beyond a small cross-fitted residue/hand Fourier baseline?

source.dependency: fresh production stream; the 20k pilot is not pooled

input.retained_contract: defined primary rows contain batch, replica, hand, nonzero residue, design marks, R/L outcomes, and D0/J0/J_after_D/D_after_J site_field, component ids, ranks, and bases

known_before_this_freeze.marginal_result: The source analysis already reported residue heterogeneity, plus peak k=1, minus peak k=10, and failure of the N325/N425 global amplitude transfer.
known_before_this_freeze.model_increment_status: No support-state versus Fourier held-out comparison had been fit.
known_before_this_freeze.classification: retrospective existing-data model freeze, not a prospective preregistration

spectral_boundary: The archive contains neither endpoint full fields nor endpoint periodograms. Delta Pminus=P_DJ-P_JD cannot be reconstructed. M_spec below is only a low-dimensional conditional-mean model for Rminus over sampled nonzero residues; it is not a terminal spectral-response test and cannot repair the unobserved residue-zero completion.

models.target: Rminus=L_DJ-L_JD on rows where both ordered supports are defined
models.sectors: fit plus and minus child hands separately while sharing the same outer batch folds
models.nuisance: intercept plus orientation levels 1..3 and fibre levels 1..4, with level zero as reference
models.frequency_selection: inside each outer training fold, residualize target and every Fourier pair on nuisance controls, rank pairs by normalized two-coordinate training SSE reduction, and select the top two with smaller k breaking ties
models.M_spec: nuisance controls plus four coordinates from the two training-only selected residue frequencies
models.Sminus_definition: For every support statistic f, [f(J_after_D)-f(J0)]-[f(D_after_J)-f(D0)]. The frozen block contains source/target rank; first relative parent-residue and fibre site harmonics; site/source-component/target-component change indicators; and source/target canonical basis-class indicators (empty, x-axis, y-axis, positive diagonal, negative diagonal, rank two; other rank-one is reference).
models.Sminus_leakage_rule: Only site_field, source_id, target_id, source_rank, target_rank, source_basis, and target_basis from the four pre-outcome support selections enter Sminus. L_D, L_J, L_DJ, L_JD, Rplus, Rminus, and all dual outcomes are forbidden predictors.
models.M_state: the identical M_spec columns selected in that training fold plus the 21-coordinate Sminus block
models.fit: standardize nonconstant predictors using training rows only; ridge lambda 1.0; intercept unpenalized; zero-variance training columns omitted

cross_fitting.dependency_unit: whole batch; this keeps both hands and every repeated replica in the same held-out fold
cross_fitting.primary_loss: squared prediction error, summarized first as an equal-batch paired reduction M_spec minus M_state
cross_fitting.secondary: row-weighted MSE and relative gain by hand; cross-fitted residual Fourier amplitudes are diagnostics only

decision.state_increment: positive equal-batch joint loss reduction with one-sided cluster t p<0.01 and positive point reduction in each child hand
decision.otherwise: no certified held-out increment from this frozen linear Sminus block; this does not exclude nonlinear or unretained state information

claim_boundary: A held-out gain would establish incremental predictive information in the retained pre-outcome typed support state for this finite adaptive intervention. It would not identify a CFT field, count physical states, reconstruct Delta Pminus, prove spontaneous path memory, or exclude alternative nonlinear/gauge descriptions.
